gate: if [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm gate; fi

checks.run: pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit build --filter=@slugbase/contracts... && pnpm contracts:check
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit --filter=@slugbase/core...
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit --filter=@slugbase/db... && pnpm db:check && pnpm test:integration --filter=@slugbase/db...
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit --filter=@slugbase/server... --filter=@slugbase/adapters... && pnpm test:integration --filter=@slugbase/server
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit build --filter=@slugbase/web... --filter=@slugbase/ui... && pnpm i18n:check
pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test:unit --filter=@slugbase/email... && pnpm i18n:check
pnpm turbo run build --filter=slugbase && docker build -f apps/slugbase/Dockerfile -t slugbase:check .

bootstrap: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi

areas.name: area:server
areas.description: HTTP server, middleware, routes, worker — packages/server

areas.name: area:ui
areas.description: coss ui components and tokens — packages/ui

areas.name: area:docs
areas.description: docs/ — design docs and threat model

risk.name: safety-critical
risk.description: Tenancy, auth, sessions, egress, secrets or migrations: Opus verifier, never bundled

maintainerOnly.name: maintainer-only
maintainerOnly.description: Needs the maintainer: legal, money, DNS, registry or production access

stale.reason: the old backend framework; the server is Hono (D12)
the old SSR web app; the app is a Vite SPA (D13)
the old symlink seam; Cloud uses a pinned submodule (D3)
retired hosting and bot protection; bot protection is Altcha (D16, D17)
retired payment provider; billing sits behind BillingPort (D18, D29)
the integration branch is dev; staging is only a deployment environment
retired UI stack, contract tool or agent harness
Phase is not used; configuration comes from environment variables (D24)
